data.title: Connect Recovery & Coaching Data to an AI Agent | TrainZilla
data.description: Give an AI agent secure access to plans, check-ins and recovery data from Apple Health or Health Connect — every plan write still reviewed by you.
data.keywords: AI agent for coaches, recovery tracking software for personal trainers, MCP fitness integration, connect coaching data to AI, Apple Health integration training app, AI workout automation

_rationale: Description listed 'clients, plans, habits and check-ins' but omitted recovery/wearable data, which is exactly the new data source this cycle's cluster is about. Refreshed to include it while keeping the existing human-review trust point front and center. Feature referenced: Recovery signals feeding the AI Coach [GAP], Apple Health / Health Connect sync [PARTIAL].
